children: New Delhi, Oct. 25 -- Shares of multiple Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), including, Bharat Electronics, Coal India, and Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL) will remain in focus this week due to their upcoming company earnings for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27.
For investors who closely track PSU Q2 results 2026, here is a closer look to their earnings preview, target price, returns potential.

Bharat Electronics LImited (BEL)'s board of directors meeting will be held on Friday, October 30. The defence PSU is expected to see revenue growth of around 16% on an annual basis, led by the healthy execution of the opening order book of Rs.720 billion, according to Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited (MOFSL).

Large orders including QRSAM, Uttam radars, next-gen corvettes, P75I, submarines, etc, will be key monitorables. "We expect margins to fall by 170bp YoY to ~27.7%, due to execution of a changing product mix," read Motilal Oswal report.
Motilal Oswal gave 'Buy' rating for the stock with a target price of Rs.530 per share, indicating a 38% upside potential. BEL share price closed 1.88% lower at Rs.360.10 per share on BSE on Friday.

Coal India's board of directors meeting is fixed for Thursday, October 29, 2026. The PSU's coal production is likely to remain muted due to seasonal weakness. Strong e-auction premium amid global uncertainty will also impact Q2 earnings.
Volume offtake post-monsoon will be key monitorable, as per Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited.
The PSU stock closed 1.08% lower at Rs.397.75 per share on BSE on Friday. Motilal Oswal gave a 'Buy' rating to the stock with a target price of Rs.500 per share, indicating 18% upside potential.

Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL)'s board of directors meeting is scheduled to be held on Friday, October 30. The PSU may see 6% annual surge in total volumes. "An increase in sales volumes from GAs - both existing and newly awarded ones - will be a key monitorable," as per MOFSL report.
MOFSL gave 'Buy' rating to IGL with a target price of Rs.191 per share, indicating 33% upside. IGL share price closed 1.43% higher at Rs.141.95 per share on BSE on Friday.
